overview.title: About iShine
overview.description: iShine is an IPL hair removal device manufacturer providing OEM and ODM services for beauty brands, from product design to global delivery.
overview.heroDescription: Leading manufacturer of IPL hair removal devices, dedicated to helping brands succeed from concept to market.
overview.summaryDescription: iShine Technology Ltd. is a B2B OEM/ODM manufacturer of home-use IPL hair removal devices that supports private-label programs for beauty brands and retailers. Founded in 2008 in Guangzhou, China, iShine provides end-to-end services across product design, prototyping, scalable production, packaging, compliance planning, and export delivery. The company references international market requirements such as FDA and CE pathways and operates with quality-system alignment including ISO 13485. iShine reports 15+ years in operation, 500,000+ devices produced, and 50+ global client partnerships, shipping to 20+ countries across North America, Europe, and the Middle East. Its work focuses on manufacturing repeatability and brand-ready execution so partners can launch and scale IPL products with consistent quality.

qualityControl.description: Multi-stage quality control for IPL devices: incoming inspection, in-process checks, functional testing, and pre-shipment audit. ISO 9001, CE, FDA certified.
qualityControl.heroSubtitle: Multi-stage inspection and testing to keep every batch stable, compliant, and retail-ready.
qualityControl.summaryTitle: How does iShine approach quality control for IPL devices?
qualityControl.summaryDescription: iShine approaches quality control for IPL devices as a multi-stage workflow designed to reduce variation and keep performance stable across production batches. Typical steps include incoming inspection of critical components, in-process verification during assembly, functional testing of device operation, and a final pre-shipment audit. QC checks often cover electrical safety, optical output verification, calibration of energy settings, thermal behavior at the treatment window, and general reliability testing. This quality-first approach helps OEM/ODM partners maintain consistent production outcomes while supporting documentation and verification needs for target markets. The intent is a retail-ready device experience where performance and safety checks are built into the process rather than treated as an afterthought.
qualityControl.philosophyParagraph: Quality is built into every step, not inspected at the end. Our process combines incoming inspection, in-process verification, functional testing, and a final pre-shipment audit to reduce variation and improve consistency across batches.

contactPage.summaryTitle: How do I start an IPL OEM/ODM inquiry with iShine?
contactPage.summaryDescription: To start an IPL OEM/ODM inquiry with iShine, share a short project brief including your target market, desired positioning, expected order quantity range, and timeline. Helpful details include the device concept (app-connected, cooling-focused, AI skin sensing, or a specific model reference), preferred packaging style, and any compliance requirements such as CE-marked configurations or documentation needs for FDA-related pathways. If you already have a BOM, reference photos, or competitor benchmarks, include them to reduce back-and-forth. After the brief is received, the next step is typically sample selection and a discussion of customization scope, MOQ, lead time, and documentation planning so the project can move into prototyping and production scheduling.
